verdict.rationale: Plaid docs confirm phone and email risk signals (new/disposable/breached, registered with external accounts) and per-session granular risk assessments (email risk, phone risk, etc.) shown in the Dashboard, which supports the phone/email risk-signal part of the story. However, there is no explicit documentation of carrier-lookup checks, address-history verification as a distinct check type, or device fingerprinting as a documented check type. missing for 10: explicit carrier check documentation, address-history check type, device fingerprint/device risk signal documentation.
